text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
My heart is racing!! Power is surging through me!!
The world is shining brighter than ever before!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I feel like running right this instant...
No, I'm going to run!!
choice_data_list: Huh!? There's still time left, isn't there...!?
Huh!? There's still time left, isn't there...!?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Even so! I can't stay still any longer!
The voice of destiny is telling me so!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Alright, Trainer, come with us too!!
Let's go! Right away! Right now!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I managed to calm her down as she tried to dash off,
and we waited for the race to begin.
